title: EpisPackageReadyToBeShipped
label: LAZADA · API REFERENCE
subtitle: External partner calls EPIS to mark a package as ready to be shipped
html:
Request Address

POST/logistics/epis/packages/rts
RegionBase URL
Vietnamhttps://api.lazada.vn/rest
Singaporehttps://api.lazada.sg/rest
Philippineshttps://api.lazada.com.ph/rest
Malaysiahttps://api.lazada.com.my/rest
Thailandhttps://api.lazada.co.th/rest
Indonesiahttps://api.lazada.co.id/rest

Common Request Parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
app_keyStringYesUnique app ID issued by LAZADA Open Platform console when you apply for an app category
timestampStringYesThe time stamp of the request e.g. 1517820392000 (which translates to 5 February 2018 08:46:32) with less than 7200s difference from UTC time
access_tokenStringNoAPI interface call credentials
sign_methodStringYesThe HMAC hash algorithm you are using to calculate your signature
signStringYesPart of the authentication process that is used for identifying and verifying who is sending a request (click <a target='_blank' href='https://open.lazada.com/apps/doc/doc?nodeId=10450&docId=108068'>here</a> for details)

Request Parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
trackingNumberStringYesUnique tracking number generated by EPIS after consignment
paidEstimatedShippingFeeStringNopaidEstimatedShippingFee

Response Parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
retryableBooleanYesIs failed request retryable?
traceIdStringYesTrace id for debugging
successBooleanYesIs success?
errorMessageStringYesError message
errorCodeStringYesError code
errorsObject[]YesDetail errors
  fieldStringYesWhen validation failed on field, the error field path will be included, begin with "$." as root object
dataObjectNoResponse data
  packageCodeStringNoUnique package identifier generated by EPIS. Used to communicate between EPIS and external systems
  trackingNumberStringNoTracking number generated by EPIS
  portCodeStringNoPort code
  routeCodeStringNoRouting code
  firstMileShippingProviderObjectNoFM TPL
    tplCodeStringNotpl code
    tplSlugStringNotpl slug
    tplNameStringNotpl name
  lastMileShippingProviderObjectNoLM TPL
  minEtaNumberNoMin promise time
  maxEtaNumberNoMax promise time
  optionsObjectNoResponse options
    vasPartialDeliveryOptionNotAvailableBooleanNoDeprecated. Please check appliedVas response. If out of lex coverage , return false for partial delivery order
    promotionCodeStringNoPromotion code
  appliedVasObjectNoCheck this data to see which VAS is successfully applied to this order
    vasFdStorageOptionBooleanNoIs FD Storage VAS applied
    vasFdCallOptionBooleanNoIs FD Call VAS applied
    vasFdCollectShippingFeeOptionBooleanNoIs FD Collect Shipping Fee VAS applied
    openBoxBooleanNoIs Open Box VAS applied
    vasPartialDeliveryOptionBooleanNoIs Partial Delivery VAS applied
    vasExchangeOrderOptionBooleanNoIs Exchange Order VAS applied
